definitions.explanation: The act of breathing in deeply and slowly. Often done to calm nerves, relax, or take in fresh air.

notes:
{深呼吸|しんこきゅう} means breathing in deeply and slowly. A compound of {深|しん} (deep) + ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧ (breathing). Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深呼吸|しんこきゅう}（⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧）⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take a deep breath)
- ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{深呼吸|しんこきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take a big deep breath)
- {深呼吸|しんこきゅう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧ (to calm down by breathing deeply)
- {深呼吸|しんこきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to take repeated deep breaths)

USAGE:
Commonly recommended as a way to calm nerves (⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ほぐす→ほぐす：10496_hogusu⟧), relieve stress, or enjoy fresh air. Often heard in medical, exercise, and relaxation contexts. Both {深呼吸|しんこきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ and {深呼吸|しんこきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ are natural.
